subject: How to plot growth curve using lavaan results

messages.author: d8517e92c7758dc2
messages.subject: How to plot growth curve using lavaan results
parts:
Hi Professors, 

I have a question regarding on plotting growth curve based on the results I got from lavaan. For example, I fit a two-slope growth curve model and get one intercept and two slopes from lavaan, I wonder whether and how I could plot this growth curve based on these results with R. If you have any similar experience, could you please share with me some information on it? 

Sorry that I am not sure whethere it's the relevant topic to ask here, if it's not, please forgive me. 

Regards 

Xueying

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: How to plot growth curve using lavaan results
parts:
Xueying

These are intercepts and slopes for predicted scores, so you can build the predicted values based on these and plot them with the basic plot function

x <- int + slope*time + slope2*time2

plot(time, x)

something like this probably
